response.sql: WITH cte1 AS (SELECT c.country, cs.constructorId, r.year, r.round, cs.wins - LAG(cs.wins, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year ORDER BY r.round) as wins_gained FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(wins_gained) as avg_wins_gained FROM cte1 GROUP BY country), all_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins_gained) as mean_all FROM country_avg), above_first_mean AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins_gained, ca.avg_wins_gained - am.mean_all as excess_all FROM country_avg ca CROSS JOIN all_mean am WHERE ca.avg_wins_gained > am.mean_all), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins_gained) as mean_above_mean FROM above_first_mean), final_countries AS (SELECT afm.country, afm.avg_wins_gained, afm.excess_all, afm.avg_wins_gained - sm.mean_above_mean as excess_above_mean FROM above_first_mean afm CROSS JOIN second_mean sm WHERE afm.avg_wins_gained > sm.mean_above_mean) SELECT AVG(avg_wins_gained), AVG(excess_all), AVG(excess_above_mean) FROM final_countries
